positions.name: CalibrationVerificationBasis
positions.frame: what grounds the calibration claim as verified — the reference-plate check performed, or the stated frequency value itself?
positions.why: All three expressions point at the same directional read: the calibration is asserted as fact (claim-level, unhedged) with its warrant located in verification against the June reference plates rather than in the bare frequency figure. src-1 states this as flowing prose, while src-2 and src-3 restate the identical instrument/value/verification content as structured field-labels — same technical-matter-of-fact register, same competence-value appeal, same claim-not-decision conviction level across all three. The set holds together because each expression answers 'what makes this calibration trustworthy' the same way: citing the reference-plate check as the evidentiary anchor, whether delivered narratively or as a compressed record.
